project_target: DeepScript: Six-Class Whole-Inscription Epigraphic Script Classifier
objective: Whole-inscription script identification on authentic stone monument captures

mendeley_tbsi.name: Tamil Brahmi Stone Inscription Dataset (TBSI v2)
mendeley_tbsi.attribution: Sukumar M, Tamil Nadu Department of Archaeology (TNDA)
mendeley_tbsi.download_status: Downloaded archive present in Downloads (127 MB, 378 files); 12 verified whole inscriptions imported to dataset/whole_inscriptions/tamil_brahmi; full metadata in dataset/tbsi_audit
mendeley_tbsi.image_type: Real stone monument photographs (cavern walls, drip-ledges, rock beds, hero stones)
mendeley_tbsi.epigraphic_labels: All 93 labeled Tamil-Brahmi; validated by TNDA and I. Mahadevan (Early Tamil Epigraphy)
mendeley_tbsi.recommendation: Use 12 already curated images for balanced training/val; reserve unselected intact sites (e.g. Vikkiramangalam, Varichiyur, Kongarpuliyankulam, Sittanavasal) for site-disjoint external stone testing. Do NOT bulk-merge all 93 images due to severe class imbalance (93 vs ~10) and extreme 8:1 aspect ratio line-strip squashing.
mendeley_tbsi.leakage_risk: High if using TBSI default split_inscription_level.csv (distributes images from same cave across train/val/test). Must group strictly by site.

kaggle_brahmi.name: Brahmi Dataset
kaggle_brahmi.author: Neha Gautam
kaggle_brahmi.license: Open Access / Academic Research (Citation required: Micro-Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering / Springer)
kaggle_brahmi.image_dimensions: Isolated glyph / character crops (32x32 to 128x128 px)
kaggle_brahmi.image_type: Isolated character / word printed & digitized crops (OCR benchmark)
kaggle_brahmi.recommendation: EXCLUDE from whole-inscription classifier. Mixing isolated printed glyphs into full monumental stone classification causes severe domain shift and violates Deepscript core architecture policy (dataset/README.md Section 3).
kaggle_brahmi.auxiliary_role: Could only be used in auxiliary character reference prototypes (character_reference/brahmi) for downstream isolated character OCR, never in whole inscription training.

huggingface_thamizhi.name: ThamizhiLetterDataset
huggingface_thamizhi.author: Sakthivelan (sakthivelan01092004)
huggingface_thamizhi.class_types: Modern Tamil letter mappings (Uyir, Mei, Uyirmei, Aytam)
huggingface_thamizhi.image_type: Isolated digital / synthetic character glyph icons
huggingface_thamizhi.recommendation: EXCLUDE from whole-inscription classifier. Lacks archaeological context, stone texture, weathering, and multi-character inscription flow.
huggingface_thamizhi.auxiliary_role: Secondary glyph reference for isolated letter decoding only.

site_leakage_audit.disjoint_split_policy_status: Enforced in DeepScript: All captures of the same monument/cavern site must be quarantined into the same split.
